newsitem.title: USA: UNION PLANTERS TO ACQUIRE CAPITAL BANCORP.
newsitem.headline: UNION PLANTERS TO ACQUIRE CAPITAL BANCORP.

text.p: Union Planters Corp, a $15-billion bank holding company, said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Capital Bancorp, a Miami, Fla., bank with $1.9 billion in assets.
Union Planters said it would exchange 0.8525 shares of its common stock for each common share of Capital.

Based on Union Planters' closing price on August 12 of 50-7/16, Capital shareholders would receive approximately $43 in Union Planter shares for each common share of Capital in a tax-free exchange, it said.
